instrument: Governor's cap on first-phase permit applications, Stratos
summary: The Governor capped first-phase permit applications for the Stratos project at 1 GW, against an originally proposed 7.5 to 9 GW.
confidence_note: Relayed; the instrument imposing the cap has not been identified or read.

source.citation: Utah news coverage, June 2026; Salt Lake Tribune, Deseret News and KSL reporting on the Stratos project
